case.summary: A $599.94 online purchase triggered a real-time model alert with a score of 0.77. The investigation requested step-up authentication; the customer entered the one-time passcode on their registered phone and confirmed the purchase from a new device. The evidence showed the amount was far above the card’s typical spend but the device profile was new, the email domain was anonymous, and the model score was treated as a weak input, all of which point to a genuine customer. The case was closed as legitimate and the transaction was allowed.
